card.name: "The" before a named historical figure
card.fires_on: The word "the" (or "his", "'s") right before a title or role that introduces a named historical person, as in "such as the philosopher Hu Shi". It appears in lists of notable figures.

modes.label: Listing notable people
modes.description: "the" after "such as" or a comma, before a role word and a person's name.
modes.example: recruited leading figures such as the philosopher Hu Shi, the scholar of Buddhism Liang Shuming,<< the>> historian Gu Jiegang, and many

modes.label: Reference to a famous person
modes.description: "the" or "'s" before a famous religious or historical figure or group.
modes.example: the dress of<< the>> Virgin Mary and the cloth that covered the

card.writes: It pushes toward names and descriptors of specific people or groups, and away from common first names like Robert or John.
card.plain: It fires on "the" when a famous person or group is about to be named or described.
